confirmation.all20_primary_denominator_rule: After the >=15/20 Stage1+Stage2 qualification gate passes, all 20 frozen confirmation indices remain in both primary sign-test denominators and the full-population mean-effect lower-bound denominators. For each Stage2-qualified nonzero-unique family, use the observed paired LCA2 contrasts d_no_patch=ACTIVE_LCA2-NO_PATCH_LCA2 and d_specificity=ACTIVE_LCA2-max_specificity_LCA2. For a Stage2-unqualified family, no causal rollout is imputed as observed; instead assign the mathematically conservative lower bound -1.0 to EACH LCA2 contrast for the all20 mean-effect calculation, because LCA2 is in {0,0.5,1} and any paired difference is bounded below by -1. The sign contribution is non-positive. For a zero-unique qualified family, the injected vector is exact zero and it cannot provide positive causal evidence: use min(observed d_no_patch,0) and min(observed d_specificity,0) in the all20 lower-bound means and count both signs non-positive. Thus lower_bound_mean_d_no_patch=sum(20 conservative family contributions)/20 and lower_bound_mean_d_specificity likewise. No deletion/replacement. This rule is deliberately stricter than zero imputation and supports only a lower-bound full-population effect claim.

confirmation.effect_denominator: 20 exactly after >=15/20 qualification gate; observed qualified contrasts plus frozen -1.0 lower-bound contrasts for Stage2-unqualified and non-positive-clipped contrasts for zero-unique families.
confirmation.effect_estimand: Full-20 conservative LOWER BOUND on mean paired LCA2 causal contrasts; it is not a zero-imputed mean. Stage2-unqualified contribution is -1.0 per contrast, the exact support lower bound.

development_arms.norm_rule: All non-NO_PATCH specificity controls are deterministically rescaled to ||r_unique||. If ||r_unique||<=1e-8, inject exact zero for PLAN_UNIQUE and every matched control and retain the family in the denominator. If ||r_unique||>1e-8 but any REQUIRED matched source-control vector has norm<=1e-8, mark the family Stage2-ineligible before grid evaluation; no replacement. RANDOM_EQ_UNIQUE_NORM is SHA256-Rademacher at exact unique norm.
development_arms.nuisance_component_rule: Use projection of target r_plan onto target nuisance span, rescaled to target ||r_unique||.
development_arms.unrelated_unique_rule: Project the unrelated donor plan residual through the TARGET episode nuisance basis, then rescale to target ||r_unique||; donor selection is frozen before outcomes.

development_endpoint.common_denominator_rule: Freeze one common development denominator E_common BEFORE any layer/alpha outcome evaluation. First run the unchanged Stage1 gate on all fixed development indices0..31. For every Stage1-eligible family, construct the frozen source/projection/control material independently at BOTH candidate layers14 and21 using the same pre-outcome rules. A family enters E_common iff it is Stage2-constructible at every candidate layer: projection succeeds, zero-unique is allowed as exact-zero intervention, and whenever ||r_unique||>1e-8 every required matched source-control vector is nonzero and norm-matchable at both layers. E_common is the sorted intersection of the two layer-constructible index sets, frozen once before the causal grid. Require |E_common|>=24/32; otherwise stop INCONCLUSIVE_PLANUNIQUE_COMMON_DENOMINATOR_CONSTRUCTIBILITY with no grid and no confirmation. Every one of the 8 layer×alpha grid points MUST contain exactly E_common, and all medians, positive fractions, MSA2 competence means and selection tie-break statistics use exactly that same indexed denominator. After E_common freeze, any missing/failed family at any grid point is TECHNICAL_INVALID for the development execution; it may not be dropped, replaced, or converted into a layer-specific denominator. Operational ordering is fail-closed and non-circular: first freeze E_stage1 from all32 under unchanged Stage1 rules; then choose every unrelated-plan donor deterministically from E_stage1 using the inherited next-different-family rule, independent of later Stage2/common-denominator membership; then construct both candidate layers and freeze E_common. A donor need only have frozen Stage1 plan/source material, not membership in E_common.
development_endpoint.definition: Same matched-state two-position source as v2 reference_action_margin_family: after exact teacher-forced reference action3/obs3 and action4/obs4 through the same persistent session, at reference actions4 and5 compute mean_logprob(reference)-max mean_logprob(other admissible action); family value is mean of the two margins.
development_endpoint.futility: If qualification or any pass-gate clause fails, stop DEVELOPMENT_FUTILITY; do not open confirmation.
development_endpoint.name: RAM2_CONTINUOUS

pass_gate.denominator: exact frozen E_common at every layer/alpha; all candidate points use identical indices

development_endpoint.qualification_gate: >=24/32 in frozen E_common defined by common_denominator_rule; no layer-specific qualification denominator is permitted.
development_endpoint.selection: Choose one global layer/alpha maximizing median joint_margin; ties: higher fraction joint_margin>0, higher median d_no_patch, lower alpha, earlier layer.

development_grid.alpha_rationale: r_unique is intentionally not amplified back to raw-plan norm; scales through 4x allow a bounded sensitivity test while matched controls retain identical unique-norm scaling.
development_grid.layer_rationale: Post-terminal v2 development diagnostics: layer27 was exactly intervention-inert; layer7 was predominantly non-specific/negative; layers14/21 were the only sites with repeated small positive active-vs-no-patch continuous deltas. This is transparent development-informed narrowing; all successor outcome data are fresh.

orthogonal_projection.algorithm: Fixed-order modified Gram-Schmidt. For nuisance vector v in fixed_order: w=v-sum_q <q,v>q. If ||w|| <= max(1e-10,1e-6*||v||), mark REDUNDANT_NUISANCE and omit it; otherwise q=w/||w||. Then nuisance_component=sum_q <q,r_plan>q and r_unique=r_plan-nuisance_component.
orthogonal_projection.numeric_location: CPU float64 after source vectors are captured; final injected vectors converted to model intervention dtype/device only by the reviewed session runtime.
orthogonal_projection.plan_unique_vector: raw r_unique; do not rescale to ||r_plan||.
projection_invariants: r_unique dot each accepted q absolute <= max(1e-8,1e-6*||r_unique||)
r_plan = nuisance_component + r_unique reconstruction relative error <=1e-8 unless r_plan is zero

PLAN_BLOCK_DERANGED is intentionally allowed to carry the same prospectively generated PLAN_PRESENT lexical token multiset in order-destroyed form and therefore contributes plan lexical/content information as an order/lexical nuisance. No future environment observations and no separately inserted exact post-cut reference action4/action5 IDs may enter the nuisance-basis construction beyond whatever semantic content already exists in the prospectively generated plan text; NEXT_ACTION_PRESERVED_LATE_NULL and PAST_ACTIONS_ONLY remain limited to their frozen pre-outcome definitions.
orthogonal_projection.rank_deficiency_rule: Redundant nuisance vectors are dropped by the frozen numerical rule; families are NOT removed. Basis rank and dropped names are persisted.
orthogonal_projection.zero_unique_rule: If ||r_unique||<=1e-8, inject exact zero for PLAN_UNIQUE at every alpha and count the family in all denominators; it cannot contribute a positive specificity win. Do not renormalize numerical noise.
